description: LEFT(str, n) / RIGHT(str, n) - the leading and trailing substrings. The interesting part is PARSING rather than semantics: LEFT and RIGHT are also join keywords, so the function form must stay callable everywhere an expression is legal, including in the same query as a LEFT OUTER JOIN and inside a procedural assignment. Converted 1:1 from functions/LeftRightFunctionTest (now retired); the empty-string result is stringified so it cannot be confused with SQL NULL.

steps.sql: SELECT LEFT(t.a, 1) FROM t LEFT OUTER JOIN u ON t.a = u.a
